Event Dates: From Jul 11, 2026 to Jul 12, 2026
Entry Deadline: Jun 27, 2026
Details:

 

Introducing GIRLAZO — the inaugural girls-only youth soccer experience at Surf Sports Park.

Inspired by those incredible moments, the golazo that won the game, and celebrated a team coming together! This event celebrates the love of the game, and the fun that all young girls have while playing a sport they love. It's a community coming together to raise girls up, find joy building their skills and confidence on and off the field. You don't want to miss it!

Girlazo is a girls-only youth soccer tournament (U8-U19) at Surf Sports Park in Del Mar, California.

The event will be held July 11-12th. 2026 and features 3 guaranteed matches for participating teams along with festival activity space filled with games, music, food trucks, merch, and more.

GU13-19 - $1495

GU11-12 - $1295

GU8-10 - $1095

Follow tournament coverage on @SurfSportsEvents on Instagram.

This is a Stay & Play tournament. All traveling teams are required to book accommodations through our travel partner, Athlete Travel. There is no opt-out for this policy so we kindly ask that you understand before submitting your application.

Tournament Dates: July 11-12, 2026
